fields.value: Irregular spacing of predominantly negative sharp complexes, with a conditional mean-interval estimate near 98 bpm. Several uneven small wavelets lie between and before selected complexes, without a uniquely identified atrial sequence. Numeric PR remains held. The selected conditional QRS envelope does not determine a width class, and neither the uneven trace nor the unresolved P identity establishes an atrial mechanism.
